# OOBE (Out of Box Experience Inc.)

> Out of Box Experience Inc. (OOBE, oobe.ca) is a Canadian IT, cloud, AI and unified communications company based in Toronto, serving clients mainly across North America (Canada and the United States) and on projects worldwide. Consulting, implementation and ongoing support from one senior team.

## Services
- IT consulting: systems design and architecture, deployment and integration, troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, documentation
- Cloud consulting: IaaS, PaaS and SaaS design, migration planning and execution, optimization and governance, multi-cloud and hybrid
- Microsoft solutions: Microsoft 365, Azure, Dynamics 365, Exchange Online and hybrid, security hardening, licensing and governance
- AI consulting, implementation and governance: readiness and roadmap, Microsoft Copilot and agent rollout, AI policy definition, governance and risk controls
- Virtualization and hypervisors: VMware and Hyper-V design, migration, optimization and monitoring
- Backup and disaster recovery: on-prem and cloud backup, Microsoft 365 data protection, DR planning, drill testing
- End-user training and cyber awareness: phishing and social engineering, security hygiene, policy and culture
- Unified communications: Cloud IP Phone (cloud VoIP, hosted PBX), Microsoft Teams Direct Routing, SMS and fax in Teams, AI contact centre, SIP trunking, number porting

## Cloud IP Phone
Cloud VoIP business phone system hosted in Canada with active-active failover, managed 24/7, AI transcripts and summaries, NG911 included. Per-user plans, monthly or annual:
- Bronze (Essentials): extensions with voicemail, caller ID and call history, browser admin portal, 24/7 voice operations
- Silver (Anywhere): everything in Bronze, browser softphone, click-to-call from web and CRM, reports and call analytics, enhanced voicemail workflow
- Gold AI (AI built in): everything in Silver, AI voicemail transcripts and summaries, voicemail transcripts via WhatsApp, SMS and fax, auto attendant (IVR), premium analytics
Contact centre, SIP trunking, numbers and analytics are quoted to usage. Includes number porting, deployment, migration and 24/7 management.

## Frequently asked questions

### General

**What does Out of Box Experience Inc. (OOBE) do?**
OOBE is a Canadian IT, cloud and unified communications company based in Toronto. We provide consulting, implementation and ongoing support for IT systems, cloud, Microsoft 365 and Azure, AI deployment and governance, virtualization, backup and disaster recovery, cyber awareness training, and Cloud IP Phone business phone systems.

**Who does OOBE work with?**
Businesses and organizations that want secure, scalable and reliable technology, from small offices to larger teams, whether they need a one-time project or a long-term IT partner.

**Which areas do you serve?**
We are based in Toronto and work with clients across the Greater Toronto Area, Canada and the United States, delivered remotely or on site.

**Can OOBE help our business adopt AI?**
Yes. We assess readiness, identify the best use cases, deploy tools such as Microsoft Copilot securely, and put written policy and governance in place so AI is used safely and responsibly.

**Can you move us to the cloud or Microsoft 365?**
Yes. We plan and carry out migrations to Microsoft 365 and Azure, including Exchange Online and hybrid deployments, and design multi-cloud and hybrid architectures.

**How do we get started?**
Call +1 (647) 825-2552, email info@oobe.ca or send a message through the contact page. We will set up a free consultation to understand your goals and recommend next steps.

### Services

**Do you offer AI consulting, implementation and governance?**
Yes. We provide AI strategy (readiness assessments, use cases and roadmaps), implement AI securely, including Microsoft Copilot, agents and automations integrated with your systems, write AI policies, and set up governance with risk controls, monitoring and compliance.

**Can you write an AI policy for our company?**
Yes. We define acceptable use, data handling and privacy rules, approved tools and Responsible AI principles, then help you roll them out and keep them current.

**Which virtualization platforms do you support?**
We design, implement and migrate VMware and Microsoft Hyper-V environments, and provide performance optimization and proactive monitoring.

**Can you back up Microsoft 365?**
Yes. Our backup and disaster recovery services include Microsoft 365 data protection, on-prem and cloud backup design, recovery planning and regular drill testing.

**Do you provide cybersecurity awareness training?**
Yes. Training covers phishing and social engineering, safe email and social media use, everyday security habits and building a security-aware culture.

**Do you support multi-cloud and hybrid environments?**
Yes. We design and support IaaS, PaaS and SaaS across multi-cloud and hybrid architectures, and help govern cost and security.

**What is unified communications (UCaaS)?**
It brings business calling, messaging, meetings and contact centre onto one cloud platform. We deliver it through Cloud IP Phone, including Teams calling, cloud PBX, SMS and fax, and AI contact centre.

**One-time projects or ongoing support?**
Both. We deliver individual projects such as migrations and deployments, and provide long-term support, monitoring and documentation.

### Cloud IP Phone

**What is Cloud IP Phone?**
OOBE's unified communications (UCaaS) platform: a cloud-hosted VoIP business phone system that replaces an on-site PBX and works on IP desk phones, computers, mobile devices and Microsoft Teams.

**Can we keep our existing numbers?**
Yes. We port your business numbers and run old and new systems in parallel during cutover, so calls are not interrupted.

**Does it work with Microsoft Teams?**
Yes. With Teams Direct Routing, Teams becomes your phone system. You can also send and receive SMS, MMS, WhatsApp and faxes inside Teams.

**Where is it hosted?**
In Canada, on carrier-grade infrastructure with active-active failover across regions, monitored 24/7.

**Which phones can we use?**
IP desk phones from Yealink, Polycom, Fanvil, Grandstream, Snom and Cisco, delivered pre-configured, or a softphone on browser, desktop or mobile.

**Is 911 supported?**
Yes. NG911 emergency calling is included with phone numbers.

**How is it priced?**
Cloud PBX is per user on monthly or annual terms, with Bronze, Silver and Gold AI plans. SIP trunking, numbers, contact centre and analytics are priced on usage. Contact us for a quote.

Yes. Out of Box Experience Inc. (OOBE) is a Canadian company based in Toronto, Ontario.

IT and cloud consulting, Microsoft 365 and Azure, AI consulting, implementation and governance, virtualization, backup and disaster recovery, cyber awareness training, and unified communications through Cloud IP Phone.

**Do you work remotely or on site?**
Both. Most work is delivered remotely, and we visit on site when a project needs it, in the Greater Toronto Area and elsewhere by arrangement.

**Do you work with clients outside North America?**
Yes. Our clients are mainly in Canada and the United States, and we also take on projects worldwide.
